_comment: Waiver register for spm x IHP-SG13G2 (plugin v1.5.58, run 2026-07-24). Every deferred step carries evidence + ticket id + review_required:true — a waiver is deferred work, not a free PASS. Authored 2026-07-25 from the run's orchestrator/audit records (addresses review finding F2). NOTE: RESULT.md of this run lists the waivers as 'FPGA + formal full-stack'; the orchestrator's WAIVED steps are rtl_gen + final_audit, and FPGA appears as SKIP in on_board_pass.json — this register reconciles all three records (review finding F3).

waivers.rationale: IC class 'digital_arithmetic_primitive' registers rtl_gen=null — the deterministic runner has no RTL generator for this class and hands authoring to the AI (skill spec-to-rtl) inside the runner pipeline. The authored RTL passed every downstream gate (lint, sim, synth, LEC).
waivers.reviewer_action: IC-expert review of the AI-authored spm.v against L1-L9 docs before tapeout release.

waivers.rationale: Analog track (A1-A9) not run: spm is a pure-digital IC and the run was dispatched with --skip-analog. Recorded as WAIVED rather than N/A so the deferral is explicit.
waivers.reviewer_action: Confirm pure-digital classification (ic_class.json) — no analog blocks exist to verify.

waivers.rationale: No DE10-class board-pin contract for this class: verification_track='generic_full_stack', half_duplex_bus=False — the AID half-duplex reference TB cannot bind this interface family, so on-board verification is deferred to board bring-up rather than executed.
waivers.reviewer_action: If silicon shuttle is planned, run a board-level bring-up on the synthesized netlist before release.

waivers.rationale: Formal verification scoped to reset-safety only (RESULT.md claims a SymbiYosys 'abc pdr' proof of p==0 one cycle after reset — NOTE: no formal/ artifact ships in this folder, review finding F4). Full-datapath functional proof is deferred to the AI assertion-gen / equivalence-miter track.
waivers.reviewer_action: Ship the SymbiYosys run directory (or its PASS log) for the reset-safety claim, and run the full arithmetic miter before claiming datapath equivalence.
